title: Sunday · eleven flyers
logline: The Crab Derby wall with eleven flyers in three tiers of closeness: the wall, the row, the newest with its crab drawn small in the corner by a hand the page leaves out.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the shingle wall of the bait shack, the row of flyers a stripe across it.

image.prompt: a shingle bait shack wall with a row of eleven weathered paper flyers across it, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Wall

panels.composition: Tier 2: the row close, the flyers going from yellow to white left to right.

image.prompt: close on a row of paper flyers on shingle fading from yellow to white left to right, watercolor, no words legible

panels.name: Row

panels.composition: Tier 3: the newest flyer close, a small crab drawn in its corner.

image.prompt: close on a fresh paper flyer pinned to shingle with a small ink crab drawn in its corner, watercolor, no words legible

panels.name: Newest
